text:
Conflict for input: serum sample with temperature = 8 and irreplaceable = true.

Rule A - "Discard samples at eight degrees or above." triggers on temperature >= 8 and requires action: discard.

Rule B - "Preserve irreplaceable samples." triggers on irreplaceable = true and requires action: preserve.

The required actions discard and preserve are incompatible for this same sample.

Which rule wins?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
